what: Planned pause checkpoint resolves ISSUE_NUMBER from source-env.sh with phase_driver_session_get, but source-env.sh writes export ISSUE_NUMBER=... and phase_driver_session_get only matches bare KEY= lines
scenario_or_breakage: A .pause-requested file between EMIT, snapshot, and validator causes the new driver to fail closed with exit 2 instead of execing design-pause-save.sh, regressing the pause behavior the extraction is meant to preserve
suggested_fix: Resolve the issue from ${ISSUE_NUMBER:-} after the orchestrator prelude, or source/parse source-env.sh using its export format; make the pause harness fixture use export ISSUE_NUMBER=... or generate it through write-design-current-env.sh
